decisions.reason: Exact source revision reviewed under the scheduled-sync repair authorization. Full old/new Git blob diff read: only the frontmatter modification timestamp changes and a dated repost paragraph, image and horizontal rule are appended. All five reference_description_sentence news objects, IDs, ordinals, titles, summaries, dates, fragment boundaries, hashes and bytes remain identical; Page fields other than contentHash are identical and dateCreated remains the 2026-10-17 date anchor. The appended text and image are outside current description-only extraction: accepting these source bytes does not create news, attach the new allegations as evidence, verify them, or approve segmentation/identity/classification changes. V4 stores only extracted news fragments; the appended body and image remain outside its content rows as well as outside the semantic graph. Preserve all existing semantic assessments and require complete candidate verification and independent replay before publication.
